en.title: Connecting Certificates to Participants
en.excerpt: Batch generating, assigning, and publishing verified digital certificates to athlete dashboards.
en.content:
Automated Batch Generation

Click Generate All Certificates in the Certificate tab. Archeris processes all verified participants, generates secure unique identifiers, and builds downloadable PDF credentials in seconds.

Manual External PDF Uploads

If your sports federation issues pre-signed government certificates with specific serial numbers, organizers can upload individual PDF files and link them to participant names via dropdown selection.

Publishing Download Access

When the tournament concludes, toggle the Publish Certificates switch to active. Athletes immediately receive access to download their high-resolution credentials.

Athlete Dashboard Notification

Published certificates appear under the My Certificates tab in each archer's personal profile.
